title: image_build_config
description: Schema for image_build_config.yml - consolidated configuration for the image_build_manager domain.

s3_configurations.description: S3 storage backend configuration for OS image storage.

endpoint_url.description: S3 endpoint URL. Required for 'powerscale' provider; auto-set for 'minio'.

aarch64_inventory_host_ip.description: IP address of the ARM admin node for aarch64 image builds. Leave empty to skip aarch64 builds.

aarch64_ssh_user.description: SSH user for connecting to the ARM build host.

repo_manager_output_path.description: Full path to repo_status.yml produced by repo_manager. Supports multiple projects.

image_build_type.description: OpenCHAMI image builder type: 'image-builder' (standard) or 'image-thrillhouse' (next-gen with extended features).

functional_groups_source.description: Where to source functional groups: 'config' derives groups from package_groups.yml keys; 'catalog' resolves groups and packages from catalog JSON (CATALOG_FILE_PATH env var).

max_parallel.description: Max concurrent image builds. 0 = unlimited (all at once).

build_timeout.description: Per-build timeout in seconds for the Python orchestrator.

force_rebuild.description: Bypass package hash cache and force rebuild of all images.

backup_s3_images.description: Copy existing S3 compute image artifacts to *_prev before rebuilding.
